summary: Click Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice and proxy statement for an upcoming general meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 30, 2026. The meeting agendas include proposals to consolidate Class A and Class B ordinary shares at a ratio between 1-for-4 and 1-for-30, with the exact ratio and effective date determined by the board within one year, and to adopt a third amended and restated memorandum and articles of association reflecting the consolidation. No price, premium, consideration, or acquisition/divestiture activity is disclosed. This is a routine capital restructuring proposal, not a special-situation event.
